main.description: A single Best / Favorite / First pick for one artist, stored in the author's repo. Record key is deterministic: `${artistKey}.${kind}` so there is at most one pick per (artist, kind). Write with putRecord (create-or-overwrite).

note.description: Optional one-line reason shown in the social feed.

artistRef.description: External reference to a music artist (artists are not atproto records).

mbid.description: MusicBrainz artist MBID (UUID), if known. Used to build the deterministic artistKey.

albumRef.description: External reference to an album / release group.

coverUrl.description: Cover art URL (e.g. Cover Art Archive). For first wire-up we store a URL; a later version may upload a blob.
